g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: AWS multi-tenant SaaS with pooled and silo tiers on ECS Fargate

g.title: None.None.Node.35
g.text: A tenant's user calls the HTTP API with a token carrying their tenant ID
API Gateway validates it against the Cognito user pool
and passes the request over a VPC link to the internal load balancer
which sends shared-tier tenants to the pooled service
The service looks up the tenant's tier and settings in DynamoDB
and works in the tenant's own schema in the pooled Aurora cluster
A premium tenant's host name routes to its own service and its own Aurora cluster
The SaaS team onboards a tenant through the admin API
which reaches the tenant management service
It publishes TenantCreated to EventBridge through the interface endpoint
A Step Functions workflow creates the tenant's Cognito group, registry entry and key
Usage events flow through Firehose to S3 for billing
